proposed_new_tag.name: mother
proposed_new_tag.definition: Any description of the man's own mother — what she did, didn't do, said, modeled, or withheld — including patterns he traces back to her influence.

quotes.why: A raw, first-time-articulated childhood pattern traced directly to his mother's behavior, surfaced live through the conversation.

quotes.quote: So there's this pattern from my mom. She would... Always try to defend me in front of my dad. And it's still to this day. So when I would have, like, a discussion with my dad, she would always try to jump in and defend me. And that would annoy me because then I would see them fighting and I wouldn't be able to really bond with my dad or, like, build a connection over, like, that... I mean, we do have a strong connection, but I think it could be way stronger if that wasn't the case. Through, like, fighting... Through fights and resolving those fights.
quotes.why: Describes a dynamic that shaped and limited his bond with his own father — directly on-tag for the father category, including recognition of what could have been stronger.
